newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foshan Lighting shareholders approve dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Foshan Lighting shareholders approve dividend plan.

text.p: Foshan Lighting and Electrical Co Ltd said on Friday that its shareholders have approved plans for a five-for-10 scrip payout for the first half of 1996.
The interim dividend proposal was approved at a meeting in the city of Foshan in Guangdong province on September 6, a company spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin.
The spokesman said Foshan Lighting expects to implement the plan this month.

Meanwhile, the official said the Shenzhen-listed firm recently reduced its stake in the Osram Foshan Lighting Co Ltd to five percent from 35 percent due to the worse-than-expected operations of the 180-million-yuan venture.
The venture, which specialises in producing bulbs mainly for automobile use, began operations last April, the official said.
The Shenzhen-listed company said in its interim report for 1996 that it posted a rise of 10.29 percent in its first-half net profits over the year earlier's level of 77.94 million yuan.
Under Chinese accounting standards, it had audited after-tax profits of 85.95 million yuan in the first half of 1996.

A company spokesman said the earnings advance was due in part to a steep rise in the firm's investment returns, which hit 34.46 million yuan versus 15.12 million yuan posted in the first six months of 1995.
Foshan Lighting said it turned out 102.51 million bulbs in the 1996 period.
